title: Justlund
body:
**Official modpack for Justlund minecraft server**

**Mods:**
- EmoteCraft + SPEmotes
- Simple Voice Chat
- ModMenu

_SPEmotes is an emote pack for the EmoteCraft mod._

This modpack that are recommended for playing on the justlund minecraft server.

Good Luck! Have fun!
